lesson.lesson: When you win something big, give part of the glory to your boss, so your success makes them shine.
lesson.wrongBelief: If I do great work, the people above me will be glad for me and reward me for it.
lesson.hookQuestion: How do you get rewarded for being brilliant without making the person above you feel small?
evidence: A scientist needed steady money for his work, and gifts from many patrons left him with small rewards and no steady support.
When he found the moons of Jupiter, he named them after the Medici and tied the discovery to their family's own symbol, so it seemed to honor them.
The family made him their official scientist with a steady salary, because his discovery now made them look great instead of making him look greater.
